title: Normalized exactness of contravariant internal derived Hom
statement: On an arbitrary small ringed site with commutative coefficients in independent universes, let H be the recorded unbounded derived internal Hom [def-pur-derived-internal-hom] and T_M(X)=H(X,M). There is a coherent integer shift structure on T_M from the opposite triangulated category, making T_M triangulated. Its degree-one component at op X is -(sourceShift X (-1)).inv.app M, and its degree-minus-one inverse component is (sourceShift X 1).hom.app M. Here sourceShift is the uniquely normalized signed comparison of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-internal-hom-exact-restriction]. M is arbitrary; no bidual or evaluation transformation occurs.

proof.text: Use the source Hom reindexing, with degree-q sign (-1)^(m*q) for E[m]. For an opposite shift n use m=-n and multiply by (-1)^q(n), q(n)=n(n+1)/2. The raw composition discrepancy is (-1)^(n*m), canceled by q(n+m)=q(n)+q(m)+n*m. Zero and addition coherence follow for all integers. At 1 the correction is -1 and at -1 it is 1. The full ordinary-to-derived normalization identifies these with precisely the displayed sourceShift components. The delivered private ordinarySignedCommShift and ordinarySignedCommShift_formula prove the ordinary zero/addition laws and the full projection formula, with naive source parameter m and correction m(m-1)/2. Reindexing m=-n gives the exponent above; localization and triangle exactness remain in this theorem.

proof.text: Apply Hom(-,I) to a cone of E to G. Its graded splitting is Hom(G,I) plus Hom(E,I)[-1], and its differential on (x,y) is (dx,dy+(-1)^(q+1)f*(x)). The map (x,y) to (x,(-1)^(q+1)y), in cone-summand order, identifies it with Cone(f*)[-1]. Rotation and the opposite triangle convention identify the connecting arrow with the negative raw degree-one comparison fixed above. Indeed the reversed third arrow has coefficient (-1)^q into the A summand of Hom(Cone(f),I)^(q+1), and the cone comparison multiplies that summand by (-1)^(q+2), giving cone inclusion. Localize and transport along cone-triangle isomorphisms to all distinguished triangles.

lean.statement:
theorem signedDerivedInternalHom_exact (M : D.{c, v, r, w} J R) :
    let T := Prod.sectL _ M ⋙ derivedInternalHomOfUniverses.{c, v, r, w} J R
    ∃ S : T.CommShift ℤ,
      (fun [_shiftInst : T.CommShift ℤ] ↦ T.IsTriangulated ∧
        (∀ X : D.{c, v, r, w} J R,
          (T.commShiftIso (1 : ℤ)).hom.app (op X) =
            -(sourceShift.{c, v, r, w} J R X (-1)).inv.app M) ∧
        (∀ X : D.{c, v, r, w} J R,
          (T.commShiftIso (-1 : ℤ)).inv.app (op X) =
            (sourceShift.{c, v, r, w} J R X 1).hom.app M)) (_shiftInst := S)
